Disclosure.title: Privacy Notice
Disclosure.pageDescription: This is a draft privacy notice prepared under Türkiye’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.
Disclosure.dialogDescription: Information about how personal data shared in the application form is processed.
Disclosure.intro: As Tüketici Birliği, we process the personal data you share during application and contact processes under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (“KVKK”). This notice is provided to inform you about our data processing activities.
Disclosure.disclaimer: This text is a draft. The final version will be updated by the legal and content teams.

dataController.title: Data controller
dataController.body: Your personal data is processed by Tüketici Birliği as the data controller.

processedData.title: Personal data processed
processedData.body: We may process your identity details (full name), contact details (phone, email), application content, company / product / service information if provided, and any documents you upload.

purposes.title: Purposes of processing
purposes.body: Your data is processed to receive and review your consumer application, contact you, keep records, and fulfil legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Your personal data may be processed based on your explicit consent, the establishment, exercise or protection of a right, and our legal obligations.

transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.body: Your data may be transferred only to the extent necessary for reviewing your application, and only where permitted by law, to competent authorities, advisors or service providers.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: Your personal data is stored for as long as required by the processing purpose and applicable limitation periods, and is then deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request correction or deletion, learn the third parties to whom it is transferred, and object to processing.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: To exercise your rights or request information about this notice, you can reach us through the contact channels on this website.
